message: Vector Rebel 3.2.82: C-shift shift-level audit now prefills attendance from existing Rebel Scout schedule evidence.
releaseNotes: C-shift Master historical 2026-11-15 and 2026-11-16 tour now retrieves the existing owner-linked, read-only Rebel Scout attendance evidence and prefills working/off suggestions. Captains review the suggestions and confirm once before mapping working-crew PPE. Uncertain evidence remains Unknown and existing captain-confirmed values are preserved. This fixes the Map Working Crew PPE blocking error caused by seven Unknown attendance statuses. The confirmation button appears before the attendance table. No CrewSense write, no assumed admin Vector access, no fake inspection completion.
